items.prompt: Why is YTM not a guaranteed realized total return?

options.text: It already includes every possible default/tax/cost outcome
options.why: It is solved from a stated promised cashflow/price model.

options.text: Payments, reinvestment, exit and costs can differ from assumptions
options.why: A price-implied rate does not ensure those future outcomes.

options.text: A positive coupon always means negative return

items.explanation: The equation is a model relation, not a promise about realized investment performance.
